title: Alamdare hussain
body:
alamdare hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala waalon ka pyara hai alamdare hussain
be-saharon ka sahara hai alamdare hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
ye khayaal aata hai ghazi tere parhcam ke talay
arsh se taygh e yadullah ki tarha haq ne
tera parcham bhi utaara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh raha hai yeho sardaab mein pani ruk kar
roz e ashoor se ab roz e jaza tak mukh par
tera bas tera ijaara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kul ke maula ne duaon mein khuda se maanga
fatema zehra ne bhi tumko kaha hai beta
ye sharaf bhi to tumhara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye pukara tha sar e karbobal deen e nabi
meri taqdeer ka maalik hai hussain ibne ali
meri qismat ka sitara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
saari dunya pe ayan hoga tera jaah o hasham
ek din aayega har ghar pe sajega ye alam
sab pukarenge hamara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis se khul jaata hai insan ka jauhar wo bhi
jis se banta hai zamane ka muqaddar wo bhi
tere abroo ka ishaara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab se anmol bhala kyun na wohi kehlaye
tere parcham ke talay tere alam ke saaye
hum ne jo waqt guzara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha bhoolenge us aalam e tanhaai ko
jis mein zehra ke dulaare ko tere bhai ko
ghayr ke laakhon ne maara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
har qadam bali sakina ka tamache khaana
raahe pur khaar mein bacchi ka tadapna rona
kis tarha tum ko gawara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
dar pe abbas ke izhaar koi bhi aaya
shadman hoke wo kehta hua yehi lauta
be-saharon ka sahara hai alamdare hussain
karbala waalon ka...
author: Ali Izhaar
